title: Hiring a Systems Programmer for Boxem
content_html:
Handmade Cities has a job referral program, where engineers and employers reach out about open roles. (It's a free community service, so I'm not getting paid.)

I'm cross-posting an unusually good opportunity from Boxem, who are writing fast shipping software and are very keen to hire a veteran C programmer:

"You will program in C and compile to linux and WASM. Linux nonblocking socket servers and WASM UI apps with modern graphics drivers. Custom versioned databases written to fit exactly the task. Write from scratch to reduce volume of code and complexity."

Few more notes:

  • Boxem's remote for now, but will open a Miami office Q2 2027, after which they'll pay for your relocation.
  • You may apply online already. Application includes salary bands and rest of the info you need
  • I know the CEO so I've invited them to Lobsters. Ask any questions for the next number of days and they'll respond here!
